title: TraderRecord
description: One record per trader/strategy-methodology source the Trader Intelligence Framework tracks (e.g. TJR, ALEX_G, JVM, or any future trader). Generic by design -- a new trader never requires a new schema, only a new instance of this one.

traderId.description: Stable, uppercase-snake identifier, never renamed. Every other entity in this framework references a trader only by this id.

aliases.description: Other names/ids this trader/strategy is known by in this repository or elsewhere (e.g. JVM's registry id 'current_strategy').

sourceChannels.description: Where this trader's external research material originates (YouTube channel, course platform, etc.) -- empty until research intake begins.

terminology.description: This trader's own vocabulary, mapped to a normalized concept name where known (e.g. {"sweep": "liquidity_sweep"}). Deliberately an open object -- vocabulary grows as research is ingested.

externalResearchStatus.description: How much of THIS trader's external, source-backed research material has been ingested into this framework. Distinct from repositoryModelStatus -- a trader can be fully operational in MOGO's codebase while its external research status is 'not_started' (e.g. ALEX_G, JVM today).

repositoryModelStatus.description: What MOGO's own codebase currently implements for this trader/strategy, independent of external research status. Use the most precise applicable term -- never an unqualified 'fully implemented'.

notes.description: Free-form, repository-confirmed facts and disclosed limitations. Must never state or imply an external trading rule that has not actually been ingested as a StrategyAssertion.
